relations.subject: Heinz Adolf Mode
relations.evidence: Gymnasium in 1919-31 in Berlin, then studies of art history, archaeology, ethnology, prehistory and Indology at Berlin.

relations.subject: Heinz Adolf Mode
relations.evidence: From 1933 studies at Colombo College in Ceylon

relations.subject: Heinz Adolf Mode
relations.evidence: After a brief while in Berlin continued his studies at Basel from 1935 and in 1937 again visited Ceylon. Ph.D. 1939 Basel.

relations.subject: Heinz Adolf Mode
relations.evidence: From 1948 Professor of Oriental Archaeology, in 1952-59 also Director of Archäologisches Seminar, Abt. Frühgeschichte des Orients at Institut für Altertumswissenschaft and University Archaeological Museum, University of Halle.

relations.subject: Heinz Adolf Mode
relations.evidence: In 1966 founded the Buddhist Centre of GDR in Halle.

relations.subject: Heinz Adolf Mode
relations.evidence: father of the art historian Markus Mode (b. 1954).

relations.subject: B. Brentjes
relations.evidence: Among his students were B. Brentjes and H. Plaeschke.
